name: io.github.JJordPy/uk-property-location-data
title: UK Property & Location Data
description: UK property due diligence for AI agents: crime, prices, flood, EPC, planning. Pay per call (x402).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool on this server with its price in USDC and what it returns. UK property and location data (crime, house prices, flood, EPC energy, planning, all-in-one due diligence report) and US flood zones, weather and ZIP demographics.

tools.name: uk_postcode_batch
tools.description: Pay-per-call bulk UK (Great Britain) postcode lookup for AI agents. Send up to 100 comma-separated postcodes in one request and get latitude/longitude, council, county, region, country, ward, parish, constituency and LSOA/MSOA for each, as clean JSON, with a per-postcode status (ok, invalid, not_found, unsupported_area). One flat price for the whole batch. Built on official ONS / Ordnance Survey open data. If no postcode is valid, the call is never charged. Great Britain only. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Up to 100 UK postcodes, comma-separated, e.g. SW1A 2AA,M1 1AE,L35 1QA. Example: SW1A 2AA,M1 1AE,ZZ99 9ZZ

tools.name: uk_crime_trend
tools.description: Pay-per-call crime trend for property and relocation AI agents. Send a postcode in England or Wales and get 12 months of police-recorded street crime within about 1 mile, the latest 3 months compared with the same 3 months a year earlier (rising, falling or stable), and the change for each crime category, with a plain-English summary, as JSON. Saves an agent 15 separate police API calls. Official data.police.uk open data (OGL). Errors never charged. Not Scotland. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England or Wales, e.g. L35 1QA. Example: L35 1QA

tools.name: uk_crime_summary
tools.description: UK crime by postcode for property and relocation AI agents. Send a postcode in England or Wales and get the latest month of police-recorded street crime within about 1 mile: total, counts by category (violence, burglary, anti-social behaviour, etc.), streets with most incidents and case outcomes, as JSON. For home-buying, lettings, insurance and 'is this area safe?' questions. Official data.police.uk open data (OGL). Errors never charged. Not Scotland. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England or Wales, e.g. L35 1QA. Example: L35 1QA

tools.name: uk_postcode_distance
tools.description: Pay-per-call distance between two UK (Great Britain) postcodes for AI agents. Send from and to postcodes (e.g. SW1A 2AA and M1 1AE) and get the straight-line distance in miles and kilometres, the compass direction and bearing, plus the council, region and coordinates of both ends, as clean JSON. Saves two lookups and the maths. Built on official ONS / Ordnance Survey open data. Invalid or unknown postcodes return an error and are never charged. Great Britain only. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

from.description: Starting UK postcode, e.g. L35 1QA. Example: L35 1QA

to.description: Destination UK postcode, e.g. SW1A 2AA. Example: SW1A 2AA

tools.name: uk_area_energy_rating
tools.description: UK home energy efficiency by postcode for property AI agents. Returns the neighbourhood's median EPC score and band (A-G), existing homes vs new builds, houses vs flats, plus the council's scores by property type and build age, compared with region and country, as JSON. For home-buying, retrofit, mortgage, landlord EPC compliance and relocation tools. Official ONS statistics (OGL). Area-level, not a single home's certificate. Errors never charged. England and Wales. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England or Wales, e.g. L35 1QA. Example: L35 1QA

tools.name: uk_flood_check
tools.description: UK flood check by postcode for property and insurance AI agents. Send a postcode in England and get official Environment Agency flood warning and alert areas within 1 km (names, river or sea, distance) plus live flood warnings within 5 km with severity and a plain-English summary, as JSON. For home-buying, conveyancing, insurance and logistics tools. Official open data (OGL). Not a property-level risk rating. Errors never charged. England only. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England, e.g. YO1 9QL. Example: YO1 9QL

tools.name: uk_postcode_nearest
tools.description: Pay-per-call nearest-postcode search for AI agents. Send a UK (Great Britain) postcode and get the postcodes around it, closest first, with distance in metres, coordinates, council and ward, as clean JSON. Optional radius (up to 2000 m, default 500) and limit (up to 100, default 10). Useful for local search, delivery areas and catchments. Built on official ONS / Ordnance Survey open data. Invalid or unknown postcodes return an error and are never charged. Great Britain only. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: UK postcode to search around, e.g. SW1A 2AA. Example: SW1A 2AA

tools.name: uk_planning_constraints
tools.description: UK planning constraints for property checks, for AI agents. Send an England postcode and get conservation area, Article 4 direction (incl. HMO rules), tree preservation zone, green belt, AONB, world heritage site, scheduled monument, SSSI, ancient woodland and planning flood zone, plus listed buildings within 100 m with grades, as JSON. For conveyancing, extensions, landlords and home-buying tools. Official planning.data.gov.uk data (OGL). Errors never charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England, e.g. YO1 9QL. Example: YO1 9QL

tools.name: lookup_uk_postcode
tools.description: Pay-per-call UK (Great Britain) postcode lookup for AI agents. Send a postcode such as SW1A 2AA and get latitude/longitude, council (local authority), county, region, country, ward, parish, parliamentary constituency and LSOA/MSOA statistical area codes, as clean JSON. Built on official ONS / Ordnance Survey open data, with the required licence attribution included. Invalid or unknown postcodes return an error and are never charged. Great Britain only (no Northern Ireland). Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: UK (Great Britain) postcode, e.g. SW1A 2AA. Example: SW1A 2AA

tools.name: uk_house_prices
tools.description: UK house prices by postcode for property AI agents. Send a postcode in England or Wales and get recorded sales nearby over 24 months: number of sales, median, lowest and highest price, median by property type, new builds, freehold share, like-for-like 12-month trend and a confidence level, as JSON. For valuations, home-buying, mortgage and lettings tools. HM Land Registry open data (OGL), no addresses. Errors never charged. Not Scotland. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Postcode in England or Wales, e.g. L35 1QA. Example: L35 1QA

tools.name: uk_location_report
tools.description: All-in-one UK property due diligence report for AI agents: one postcode returns street crime, neighbourhood EPC energy rating, flood warning areas, house prices with like-for-like trend, and planning constraints (conservation area, Article 4 HMO rules, listed buildings, green belt), with plain-English highlights, as JSON. Built for home-buying, conveyancing, mortgage, lettings and relocation tools. Official open data (OGL). Cheaper than separate calls. Errors never charged. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: UK postcode, e.g. YO1 9QL. Example: YO1 9QL

tools.name: us_fema_flood_zone
tools.description: Pay-per-call FEMA flood zone lookup for US real estate, mortgage and insurance AI agents. Send a US street address (or lat/lon) and get the official FEMA flood zone (A, AE, VE, X, etc.), risk level, whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area, whether flood insurance is typically required for a mortgage, and base flood elevation, as JSON. FEMA's map servers are slow and complex for agents; this is one call. Public domain data. Errors never charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

address.description: US street address, e.g. 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500 (or send lat and lon instead). Example: 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of address). Example: 38.8977

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of address). Example: -77.0365

tools.name: us_property_report
tools.description: All-in-one US property report for real estate, mortgage and insurance AI agents. Send a US street address and get the FEMA flood zone with flood insurance requirement, live National Weather Service alerts and forecast, and the ZIP code's Census profile (income, home values, rents, owners vs renters, poverty, education), with plain-English highlights, as JSON. Cheaper than separate calls. Official public domain data. Errors never charged. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

address.description: US street address, e.g. 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500 (or send lat and lon instead). Example: 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of address). Example: 38.8977

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of address). Example: -77.0365

tools.name: us_weather_alerts
tools.description: Pay-per-call US weather for AI agents. Send a US street address (or lat/lon) and get all active National Weather Service alerts at that point (tornado, flood, winter storm, heat, etc.) with severity, urgency, timing and safety instructions, plus the next 4 forecast periods (temperature, wind, chance of rain, summary), as clean JSON. For travel, logistics, insurance, events and real estate agents. Official NWS data (public domain). Errors never charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

address.description: US street address, e.g. 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500 (or send lat and lon instead). Example: 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of address). Example: 38.8977

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of address). Example: -77.0365

tools.name: us_zip_demographics
tools.description: Pay-per-call US ZIP code profile for AI agents. Send a 5-digit ZIP and get population, median age, median household and per-capita income, median home value and rent, owner vs renter share, poverty rate, unemployment rate and share with a bachelor's degree or higher, as clean JSON. Official U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 5-year data (public domain). Unknown ZIPs return an error and are never charged. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).
